# Story 15 — Ticket detail: conversation, notes, attachments, quick replies, customer context (Story: 506)

## Prerequisites

- Story 4.1 completed — ticket aggregate, message write path, optimistic version guard.
- Story 4.2 completed — ticket list + read endpoints.
- Story 4.3 completed — ticket single read endpoint / status transitions.
- Story 3.2 completed — attachment upload endpoints and storage adapter.
- Story 2.3 completed — quick replies stored under the Platform settings collection (see `backend/app/Modules/Platform/Http/Controllers/Admin/QuickRepliesController.php` and `frontend/components/screens/admin/QuickReplyList.tsx`).
- Coordinate with the owner of `messages.delivery_state` (Story 5.1) — this story writes the enum but does not drive transitions past `queued`.
- Attachment on this intake: `.squad/stories/inti/506/attachments/direction-e2-workspace.html` — the canonical UX reference. Open in a browser before executing.

---

## Story Goal

Give an agent a single workspace to answer a customer without leaving the ticket:

1. A three-column detail screen at `/tickets/[id]` — conversation in the centre, property rail on one edge, customer context on the other.
2. A conversation timeline with three **semantic** treatments — customer, agent, internal note — and no fourth (no AI draft).
3. A composer that appends replies, notes and attachments through the Story 4.1 command path, caches drafts in `localStorage`, and lets an agent insert a quick-reply body without variable substitution.
4. A property rail that edits status, priority, category, assignee and department under the **version guard**, showing SLA as read-only.
5. A customer context panel populated by a **single aggregate query** — no N+1 across counts.

Explicitly **out of scope** (visible in mockup, not built here): AI panel & AI-draft treatment, mention/follow controls, tasks & reminders tab, escalate/link/merge, knowledge panel, organisation chip.

## Product rules (from story)

- **Append vs change under the version guard** —
  - `POST` reply / note / attachment: **append**, carries no `If-Match`, is **never** refused as stale.
  - `PATCH` property rail: **change**, carries `If-Match: <version>` loaded with the screen, `409` on mismatch with `title="Ticket has changed"` and a `reload` action hint in the ProblemDetails extension.
- **Internal notes** carry the literal string "Not visible to the customer" (localised: `ticket.internalNote.badge`) and MUST NOT reach the customer email pipeline or any customer-facing endpoint.
- **Quick replies** — the picker fetches the shared list, inserts the raw `body` string into the composer at the caret. **No** placeholder expansion, no server-side render, no auto-send.
- **Draft cache** — key `ticket.draft.<ticketId>` in `localStorage`, cleared on successful send.
- **Customer context** — computed via one aggregate query (see backend task 2); rendered inline; does **not** pop the ticket from the router.

## Backend Tasks

### 1 — Ticket detail read endpoint

**File: `backend/app/Modules/Tickets/Http/Controllers/TicketDetailController.php`** (new)

- Route: `GET /api/tickets/{ticket}` (register in `TicketsServiceProvider.php`).
- Guarded by `RequireCapability::class.':tickets.view'` and scoped through `TicketVisibility`.
- Response includes: ticket fields, current version, SLA snapshot (read-only), assignee, department, category, priority, status, and a `_links` block to `/api/tickets/{id}/messages` and `/api/customers/{id}`.
- Response header: `ETag: W/"<version>"` so the frontend can send it back as `If-Match`.

### 2 — Customer context aggregate

**File: `backend/app/Modules/Tickets/Http/Controllers/CustomerContextController.php`** (new)

- Route: `GET /api/tickets/{ticket}/customer-context`.
- Returns: contact details, department, `open_ticket_count`, `recent_ticket_count` (last 30 days), `last_interaction_at`.
- **Implementation must be a single query.** Prefer a subquery or `withCount(['tickets as open_ticket_count' => fn($q) => $q->whereIn('status', [...open statuses...])])` + `withMax('tickets as last_interaction_at', 'updated_at')`. Add a Feature test that asserts `DB::getQueryLog()` length ≤ 2 (one for context, one for the ticket read).

### 3 — Conversation (messages) endpoints

**File: `backend/app/Modules/Tickets/Http/Controllers/MessagesController.php`** (new)

- `GET /api/tickets/{ticket}/messages` — returns messages ordered ascending by `created_at`, each with `direction` (`customer|agent|internal`), `sender`, `recipient`, `body`, `attachments[]`, `created_at`, `delivery_state`.
- `POST /api/tickets/{ticket}/messages` — appends a message. Accepts `type in {reply, note}`, `body`, `attachment_ids[]`. **No** `If-Match`. Idempotent via `Idempotency-Key`.
- `POST /api/tickets/{ticket}/messages/{message}/retry` — for failed sends (UX-09); marks `delivery_state=queued` and re-emits the Story 5.1 event.
- Persist through the Story 4.1 command bus — do not write directly to the model.
- Notes MUST be excluded from anything customer-facing; add a scope `Message::customerVisible()` and use it in outbound mail composition.

### 4 — Property rail update endpoint

**File: `backend/app/Modules/Tickets/Http/Controllers/TicketPropertiesController.php`** (new)

- `PATCH /api/tickets/{ticket}` — accepts any subset of `status`, `priority`, `category_id`, `assignee_id`, `department_id`.
- Enforce `If-Match` header. On mismatch, return `409 Conflict` via `ProblemException` with `type=/problems/ticket-version-conflict`, `title="Ticket has changed"`, extension `{ current_version: <int>, reload_hint: true }`.
- Guarded by `tickets.edit`.
- SLA is not accepted in the request; ignore silently or return `422` on presence — pick the pattern used by `CategoriesController` (`422`).

### 5 — Quick replies read for composer

- No new backend work; the frontend calls the existing `GET /api/admin/quick-replies` from `QuickRepliesController`. Confirm the endpoint is authorised for the `tickets.reply` capability holders — add a `viewAny` policy check or broaden the middleware to include agents.

### 6 — Capabilities, routes, OpenAPI

- Add capability strings `tickets.view`, `tickets.reply`, `tickets.note`, `tickets.edit` to `backend/app/Modules/Security/Domain/Capabilities.php` if missing. Update `RolesAndPermissionsSeeder.php`.
- Register routes in `TicketsServiceProvider.php` mirroring the Admin block already there.
- Run `php artisan openapi:generate` (`OpenApiGenerateCommand`) and commit the diff in `backend/openapi.yaml`.

## Frontend Tasks

### 1 — Route and screen scaffolding

**Create file: `frontend/app/tickets/[id]/page.tsx`**

- Server component that renders `<TicketDetailScreen id={params.id} />`.
- Wrapped by the standard `AppShell` (see `frontend/components/shell/AppShell.tsx`).

**Create file: `frontend/components/screens/tickets/TicketDetailScreen.tsx`**

- Three-region layout: **PropertyRail** (left in LTR, right in RTL), **ConversationPanel** (centre), **CustomerContextPanel** (right in LTR).
- At `<=390px` collapses to a single column with tabs `Conversation | Properties | Customer` (see mockup).
- Fetch `GET /api/tickets/{id}` and `GET /api/tickets/{id}/customer-context` in parallel; surface `ForbiddenState` on 403, `EmptyState` on 404.

### 2 — Conversation timeline with three treatments

**Create file: `frontend/components/screens/tickets/ConversationPanel.tsx`**

- Reads `GET /api/tickets/{id}/messages`.
- Renders one of three visual treatments based on `direction`:
  - `customer` — inbound bubble, timestamp, sender name.
  - `agent` — outbound bubble, agent name, `delivery_state` chip (`queued|sent|failed`).
  - `internal` — muted callout with the localised badge "Not visible to the customer" (`ticket.internalNote.badge`).
- Failed sends show `Retry` and `Edit` buttons (UX-09) — `Retry` posts to the retry endpoint; `Edit` re-hydrates the composer with the failed body.
- No AI-draft treatment; do **not** create an `AiSuggestionPanel` file.

### 3 — Composer with attachments + quick reply picker + draft cache

**Create file: `frontend/components/screens/tickets/Composer.tsx`**

- Textarea + tab toggle `Reply | Internal note`.
- Attachment picker reuses `frontend/components/ui/file-input.tsx`; uploaded IDs are collected and posted with the message.
- Quick reply picker: dropdown listing entries from `GET /api/admin/quick-replies`; on select, insert `body` at the caret and refocus the textarea. **No** placeholder expansion.
- Draft cache: on every change, write `{body, type, attachmentIds}` to `localStorage.setItem('ticket.draft.'+id, ...)`; on mount, hydrate from it; on successful `POST /messages`, `localStorage.removeItem('ticket.draft.'+id)`.
- Send never carries `If-Match`; the composer must not be blocked by a stale version conflict.

### 4 — Property rail with version guard

**Create file: `frontend/components/screens/tickets/PropertyRail.tsx`**

- Fields: status, priority, category, assignee, department (editable); SLA (read-only).
- On mount, capture `ticket.version`. Each PATCH sends `If-Match: W/"<version>"`.
- On `409`, show an inline `FormAlert` with the ProblemDetails title and a `Reload` button that refetches the ticket + messages and dismisses the alert. Do not clobber the composer state.

### 5 — Customer context panel

**Create file: `frontend/components/screens/tickets/CustomerContextPanel.tsx`**

- Renders contact details, department, `open_ticket_count`, `recent_ticket_count`, `last_interaction_at`.
- "Open full customer record" link routes to `/customers/[id]` in a new tab or via `router.push` while preserving the ticket route via query string (`?returnTo=/tickets/<id>`), so the agent can return without losing scroll position — reuse the existing pattern in `TopBar.tsx` if one exists.

### 6 — i18n + tokens

- Add strings to `frontend/messages/en.json` and `frontend/messages/ar.json` under a new `ticket` namespace: `internalNote.badge`, `composer.reply`, `composer.note`, `composer.quickReplies`, `composer.attach`, `composer.send`, `propertyRail.*`, `context.*`, `conflict.title`, `conflict.reload`.
- Ensure all layout uses `logical` CSS (start/end, `me-*`, `ms-*`) — verify with existing `DataTable.rtl.test.tsx` patterns.

### 7 — API types

- After backend OpenAPI regen, run `pnpm --filter frontend run api:generate` (see `frontend/scripts/api-client.mjs`) to refresh `frontend/lib/api/schema.ts`.

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **Stale version on PATCH** — backend returns `409` with `current_version`; frontend renders alert with `Reload`. Enforced in `TicketPropertiesController` and `PropertyRail.tsx`.
- **Send while ticket reassigned** — composer POST carries no `If-Match`; the append succeeds. Test: reassign in one tab, send from another — send succeeds, message appears with the correct actor.
- **Attachment upload fails after body typed** — draft in `localStorage` retains body; attachment IDs are only appended on success.
- **`localStorage` disabled / private mode** — composer gracefully falls back to in-memory state; no throw. Guard `try/catch` in Composer.tsx.
- **Internal note leakage** — outbound email composer must import `Message::customerVisible()`. Add architecture assertion in a Feature test that the mail job never sees an internal message.
- **Failed send retry loop** — `Retry` endpoint is idempotent on `message.id`; two rapid clicks do not create duplicates. Enforced by `Idempotency-Key` middleware.
- **N+1 on context panel** — `CustomerContextController` covered by a query-count test (`DB::enableQueryLog()`), fail if > 2.
- **RTL** — timestamps, delivery-state chips and quick-reply dropdown all use logical properties; verified by a snapshot test with `dir="rtl"`.
- **390px** — three-region layout collapses to tabs; the composer sticky bar remains reachable above the keyboard.
- **Missing quick replies** — picker shows `EmptyState` inline; composer still works.
- **Unauthorised (agent lacks `tickets.edit` but has `tickets.reply`)** — PropertyRail renders read-only; composer still works. Enforced by capability check in the screen.
- **Ticket deleted mid-view** — 404 on any subsequent action; screen replaces with `EmptyState` + link back to `/tickets`.

## Test Plan

**Backend (Feature tests under `backend/tests/Feature/Tickets/`):**

1. `TicketDetailReadTest.php` — asserts response shape, ETag header, capability enforcement, visibility scoping via `TicketVisibility`.
2. `TicketPropertiesPatchTest.php` — happy path per field; `409` on `If-Match` mismatch with expected ProblemDetails body; `422` if SLA field present.
3. `TicketMessagesAppendTest.php` — reply, note, and attachment cases; no `If-Match` required; idempotency via repeated `Idempotency-Key`.
4. `TicketMessagesRetryTest.php` — moves `delivery_state` from `failed` to `queued`, emits the Story 5.1 event once.
5. `InternalNoteNotDeliveredTest.php` — outbound mail job called with the ticket's messages sees zero `internal` rows.
6. `CustomerContextAggregateTest.php` — asserts `DB::getQueryLog()` count ≤ 2 across seeded fixture of 20 tickets on the same customer.
7. Extend `backend/tests/Architecture/CapabilitiesInSyncTest.php` implicit coverage — add the new capability constants.

**Frontend (under `frontend/__tests__/components/screens/tickets/`, add folder):**

1. `TicketDetailScreen.layout.test.tsx` — renders three regions at desktop, tabs at 390px.
2. `ConversationPanel.treatments.test.tsx` — three semantic treatments render; internal note contains the badge string; no AI treatment ever renders.
3. `Composer.draft.test.tsx` — draft written to `localStorage` on change, hydrated on mount, cleared on send.

## Migration / Rollback

- No new schema migrations in this story unless prior stories missed them; if `messages.delivery_state` column is absent, defer to Story 5.1's migration and mark the composer feature-flag off.
- Rollback: revert the routes registered in `TicketsServiceProvider.php`; regenerate `openapi.yaml`; the frontend page is additive (`/tickets/[id]`) and can be removed without affecting the admin surface.

## Verification Steps

1. **Backend builds:** `cd backend && composer install && php artisan migrate && ./vendor/bin/phpunit --testsuite Feature --filter Tickets`.
2. **Backend contract:** `cd backend && php artisan openapi:generate && php artisan openapi:check`.
3. **Frontend runs:** `cd frontend && pnpm install && pnpm dev` and open `http://localhost:3000/tickets/<seeded-id>`.
4. **Frontend tests:** `cd frontend && pnpm test -- tickets`.
5. **A11y:** `cd frontend && pnpm test -- a11y/pages`.
6. **RTL manual:** switch locale to `ar` via the language toggle; verify property rail sits on the left, conversation reads right-to-left, composer send button on the start edge.
7. **390px manual:** Chrome devtools iPhone 12 mini viewport — verify tabs collapse and composer is reachable above the keyboard.
8. **Regression:** `cd backend && ./vendor/bin/phpunit --testsuite Architecture` (capabilities, module boundaries, no-cross-import) and `cd frontend && pnpm test -- no-cross-import lint-rules`.

> **Two deviations from the plan, both deliberate.**
>
> **Capabilities.** The plan names `tickets.view/reply/note/edit`. This
> repository has used singular `ticket.*` since Story 2.2, and the endpoints
> here reuse `ticket.read` and `ticket.update` rather than introducing a second
> vocabulary for the same permissions. Adding four synonyms would mean every
> future route has to guess which family it belongs to.
>
> **The version guard.** The plan specifies `If-Match` and a new
> `TicketPropertiesController`. `If-Match` is now accepted — and the read
> returns `ETag: W/"<version>"` — but it feeds the SAME `VersionGuard` the body
> `version` already fed, on the existing endpoint. A parallel mechanism would
> be a second thing to get wrong, and the one that is wrong is the one nobody
> tested. Both spellings are covered by `TicketPropertiesPatchTest`.
>
> **Screen usable at 390px** is asserted by test (the tab layout renders and
> switches panes); it has not been confirmed on a physical device. Story 1.4
> carries the same open item.
